condition_selection: All prescribed compositions with supported multiatom and backbone-changing proposals in the frozen TRAINING-geometry screen; no energy ranking.
parent_selection: First4 chemically supported DEVELOPMENT source parents, without further filtering or energy ranking.
cost_contract: Actual paired oracle calls and source512 plus shared warm preparation per condition. Initial warm endpoints are rechecked in each arm. Equal step and maximum-query caps are not exact actual-cost matching.
stop_rule: This physical feasibility pilot must establish whether valid backbone edits survive energy correction. No AI novelty, equilibrium, independent sampling efficiency or broad chemistry claim follows from a support/acceptance count.
